channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Ski Length Calculator — Right Ski Size by Height, Weight and Skill
item.description: What length skis do you need? Height, weight and skill give the length in centimetres, the range either side, and the weight caveat shops skip. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Ski Rental vs Own Calculator — Break-even Days per Year
item.description: Rent or buy skis? Days per year against rental price, kit cost and servicing give the break-even years - with the own-skis-rent-boots hybrid. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Ski Trip Cost Calculator — Per-Person Budget by Days on Snow
item.description: What does a ski trip cost? Days, lift pass, rental, lessons and mountain food give the per-person total, the lift share and the season-pass crossover. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Leftover Storage Calculator — Eat or Freeze By Date
item.description: How long are leftovers good? Cook date and food type give the use-or-freeze date, the freezer extension and the one-reheat rule. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Holiday Shipping Calculator — Last Safe Posting Date
item.description: When must holiday parcels be posted? Arrival date and destination give the last safe posting day, peak-season buffer and the online order deadline. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Turkey Thaw Calculator — Start Date, Oven Time and Rest
item.description: When to start thawing the turkey? Serving date and weight give the fridge-thaw start date, oven time at 175°C and the rest before carving. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Fertilizer Dilution Calculator — ml per Watering Can
item.description: How much plant feed per can? Label dose times can size times season gives the ml - with the salt-burn signs and the half-strength default. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Repot Size Calculator — Next Pot Diameter and Soil Needed
item.description: What size pot next? Current diameter gives the +2-3 cm upgrade, the litres of potting soil to buy, and the root-bound signals worth checking. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Plant Watering Calculator — Days Between Waterings
item.description: How often should you water your houseplant? Pot size, plant type, season and light give the interval in days, litres per watering and the finger-test law. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Winter Tire Calculator — the 7°C Rule and Three-Year Cost
item.description: Do you need winter tires? Morning temperature against the 7°C rule gives the grip verdict, plus the two-sets-versus-all-season three-year cost. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Following Distance Calculator — the Two-Second Rule in Metres
item.description: How far behind should you follow? Speed and headway seconds give the gap in metres and car lengths, plus the marker method and reaction-gap cost. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Stopping Distance Calculator — Reaction + Braking by Road
item.description: How far does your car take to stop? Speed times reaction time plus braking physics by road surface - dry, wet, snow, ice - in metres and car lengths. Free.

item.title: Carry-On Size Calculator — Does Your Bag Fit Cabin Rules?
item.description: Will your bag board? Length, width, depth against the four common airline frames give a fits verdict, the spare centimetres and the gate-check risk. Free.

item.title: Real vs Artificial Christmas Tree Calculator — Break-even Christmases
item.description: Real tree every year or artificial once? Price both, find the break-even Christmas count and the carbon verdict - the 10-use rule explained. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Food Waste Calculator — What Your Bin Costs Per Year
item.description: What does your household bin? Weekly food waste in kg times price gives the yearly total, per-person share and the shopping-list slice. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Standby Power Calculator — What Idle Electronics Cost You
item.description: The always-on leak: standby watts times hours times price gives the yearly cost of idle electronics - with the warm-when-off hunt and the switchable-lead fix. Free.

item.title: Shower vs Bath Calculator — Real Cost per Wash
item.description: Shower or bath - which costs less? Minutes, flow and energy price give the weekly cost of each, the litres saved, and the exact crossover time. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Dripping Tap Calculator — Litres and Money Down the Drain
item.description: What does a dripping tap waste? Drips per minute times the clock gives litres per year and cost, hot-tap doubling and the meter leak test. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Pet Treat Calculator — The 10% Rule in Pieces per Day
item.description: How many treats can your pet have? The veterinary 10% rule turns daily food calories into a treat budget, in pieces, with the human-food dangers listed. Free.

item.title: Cat Food Portion Calculator — Grams per Day by Weight and Stage
item.description: How much should your cat eat? Weight and stage give kcal by the feline RER formula, then grams from the bag - plus the 4-meal rhythm and scale discipline. Free.
